title: PJ's Mechanics
description: Enhance your survival Minecraft server with new QOL and fun mechanics that you won't be able to play without.
body:
# PJ's Mechanics  
This plugin adds in a number of miscellaneous mechanics into Minecraft intended to enhance the survival experience.

## ⚾ New Throwables ⚾
A number of items can now be thrown with various effects.
| **Item** | **Effect** |
| --- | --- |
| **Torches** | Throw them to place them on walls at a distance. Torches will also briefly set entities on fire if hit. |
| **End Rods** | Will also land on walls but can also land on ceilings. Applies glowing effect to entities if hit. |
| **Snowball** | Applies freezing effect |
| **Slime Ball, Clay Ball** | Applies mining fatigue and slowness |
| **Magma Cream** | Applies mining fatigue, slowness, and sets on fire |
| **Ink Sac** | Applies blindness |
| **Glow Ink Sac** | Applies glowing effect |
| **Fire Charge** | Shoots a small fireball when thrown |
| **Cobweb** | Is placed down wherever projectile lands. If an entity is hit, it will be placed at their feet. |
## 🥕 Farming 🥕
Right-clicking on fully grown crops with a hoe automatically harvests and replants the crop. Works with enchantments like Fortune and Unbreaking.
####
## 🪶 Soft Landing Blocks 🪶
Some blocks now can be landed on to take reduced fall damage:
* Wool
* Leaves
* Snow
Falling from high enough may cause you to fall through the block.
####
## 🕶️ Blindness Mechanic 🕶️
When a hostile mob has the blindness effect, it will be unable to target you. For example, if you throw an ink sac at a zombie that is chasing you, it will stop following you.
####
## ⚒️ Salvage Mechanic ⚒️
Dropping tools/armor into the result slot of a crafting table will break it down, returning some of the primary resource.
* Items with durability will return the same fraction of original resources as they have remaining durability.
* The following can also be deconstructed for their primary mineral: **minecarts**, **clocks**, **iron doors**, **shears**, **cauldrons**, **buckets**.
* Netherite tools/armor cannot be salvaged.
####
## 📃 More Misc Mechanics 📃
### Pick Up Boats/Minecarts
Shift + Right-Clicking an empty boat or minecart will automatically pick it up.

### Gold Trim & Piglins 
Having any amount of gold armor trim will protect you from being aggro'd by piglins.

### Pumpkin Head
Right-clicking an armorable mob with a carved pumpkin will put it on it's head, having the same effect as blindness.

### Rain Bucket
Empty buckets will slowly fill in the rain when held.

### Portable Ender Chest
Right-clicking with an ender chest in your hand will open it.
###
### 🔭 Future Development 🔭
One of the main feedback items this plugin got on SpigotMC was the request for settings, i.e. the ability to toggle on/off different features. I intend to implement this and keep this resource free.
#
### ✍️ A Note From the Author ✍️
I started this plugin back in 2020 with the intent to only use it for myself or on small servers with friends. From my own experience and the feedback I got from friends, these features were so useful and in many cases just common-sense that it was very hard to go back to playing Minecraft without them. I recently started playing a vanilla realm, and not being able to throw torches is *excruciating*.

I published this plugin to SpigotMC.org in 2024 under the name "RPG Mechanics". This was named after my own server, not necessarily a Role Playing Game, so after a personal rebrand it is now PJ's Mechanics. You can find previous reviews for this plugin [there](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/pjs-mechanics.114651/).
#
